engine_run_creations_state_check.name: engine_run_creations_state_check
engine_run_creations_state_check.value:
(
        "engine_run_creations"."state" = 'created'
        AND "engine_run_creations"."request_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND length("engine_run_creations"."request_hash") = 64
        AND "engine_run_creations"."request_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND "engine_run_creations"."run_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "engine_run_creations"."reconciliation_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "engine_run_creations"."state" = 'confirmed_not_created'
        AND "engine_run_creations"."request_hash" IS NULL
        AND "engine_run_creations"."run_id" IS NULL
        AND "engine_run_creations"."reconciliation_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND length("engine_run_creations"."reconciliation_id") = 36
        AND substr("engine_run_creations"."reconciliation_id", 1, 4) = 'ncp_'
        AND substr("engine_run_creations"."reconciliation_id", 5)
          NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      )

engine_run_creations_retention_check.name: engine_run_creations_retention_check
engine_run_creations_retention_check.value:
"engine_run_creations"."created_at" = "engine_run_creations"."updated_at"
        AND julianday("engine_run_creations"."created_at") IS NOT NULL
        AND julianday("engine_run_creations"."retain_until") IS NOT NULL
        AND julianday("engine_run_creations"."retain_until")
          >= julianday("engine_run_creations"."created_at") + 30

run_deadline_operations_lease_fence_chec.name: run_deadline_operations_lease_fence_check
run_deadline_operations_lease_fence_chec.value:
("run_deadline_operations"."lease_id" IS NULL AND "run_deadline_operations"."fence" IS NULL)
        OR ("run_deadline_operations"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "run_deadline_operations"."fence" >= 1)

run_engine_excerpts_bytes_check.name: run_engine_excerpts_bytes_check
run_engine_excerpts_bytes_check.value:
"run_engine_excerpts"."stdout_excerpt_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1024
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."stderr_excerpt_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1024
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."stdout_excerpt_bytes" + "run_engine_excerpts"."stderr_excerpt_bytes" <= 1024

run_engine_excerpts_crypto_state_check.name: run_engine_excerpts_crypto_state_check
run_engine_excerpts_crypto_state_check.value:
(
        "run_engine_excerpts"."erased_at" IS NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."key_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."tag" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "run_engine_excerpts"."erased_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."key_id" IS NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."iv" IS NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "run_engine_excerpts"."tag" IS NULL
      )

run_engine_receipts_stream_bytes_check.name: run_engine_receipts_stream_bytes_check
run_engine_receipts_stream_bytes_check.value:
"run_engine_receipts"."stdout_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 262144
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."stderr_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 65536
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."stdout_excerpt_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1024
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."stderr_excerpt_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1024
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."stdout_excerpt_bytes" + "run_engine_receipts"."stderr_excerpt_bytes" <= 1024

run_engine_receipts_digests_check.name: run_engine_receipts_digests_check
run_engine_receipts_digests_check.value:
length("run_engine_receipts"."stdout_sha256") = 64
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."stdout_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("run_engine_receipts"."stderr_sha256") = 64
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."stderr_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("run_engine_receipts"."excerpt_sha256") = 64
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."excerpt_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("run_engine_receipts"."receipt_sha256") = 64
        AND "run_engine_receipts"."receipt_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

run_prompts_crypto_state_check.name: run_prompts_crypto_state_check
run_prompts_crypto_state_check.value:
(
        "run_prompts"."erased_at" IS NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."key_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."tag" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "run_prompts"."erased_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."key_id" IS NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."iv" IS NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "run_prompts"."tag" IS NULL
      )

runner_capability_evidence_version_check.name: runner_capability_evidence_version_check
runner_capability_evidence_version_check.value:
"runner_capability_evidence"."version" IS NULL OR (
        length(CAST("runner_capability_evidence"."version" AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64
        AND "runner_capability_evidence"."version" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z._+-]*'
        AND substr("runner_capability_evidence"."version", 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9A-Za-z]'
      )

runner_capability_reports_response_check.name: runner_capability_reports_response_check
runner_capability_reports_response_check.value:
"runner_capability_reports"."response_status" BETWEEN 100 AND 599
        AND ("runner_capability_reports"."response_body" IS NULL OR length(CAST("runner_capability_reports"."response_body" AS BLOB)) <= 65536)

runner_engine_evidence_version_check.name: runner_engine_evidence_version_check
runner_engine_evidence_version_check.value:
"runner_engine_evidence"."version" IS NULL OR (
        length(CAST("runner_engine_evidence"."version" AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64
        AND "runner_engine_evidence"."version" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z ._+()-]*'
        AND substr("runner_engine_evidence"."version", 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9A-Za-z]'
      )

runner_engine_reports_response_check.name: runner_engine_reports_response_check
runner_engine_reports_response_check.value:
"runner_engine_reports"."response_status" BETWEEN 100 AND 599
        AND ("runner_engine_reports"."response_body" IS NULL OR length(CAST("runner_engine_reports"."response_body" AS BLOB)) <= 65536)
